title: Chapter 190: The Undead Book Officer
content:
Chapter 190: The Undead Book Officer

He has basically figured it out now. Bronze bosses are equivalent to primary military commanders of humans, and silver bosses are equivalent to intermediate military commanders.

Xu Wen is at level 40, and is also an intelligent boss.

It looks like a fierce battle!

Wang Shuo still remembers that he paid a huge price to deal with the black-robed wizard in the dungeon of Black Dragon City last time.

"Everyone be careful!"

Wang Shuo did not expect that he would face a silver boss so soon, and he was not mentally prepared at all.

"A group of petty thieves dared to break into the forbidden area of the lord's mansion. They simply don't know how to live or die."

Xu Wen stood up, and a few words popped out from the mouth of the skeleton under his official hat.

"Three people make a tiger."

In an instant, three skeleton knights riding tigers appeared in front of him, and the tigers were naturally only skeletons.

"What? Is this what 'three people make a tiger' means?"

Wang Shuo was shocked.

It can still be played like this.

Not daring to be careless, Wang Shuo immediately focused on responding.

This skeleton soldier riding a tiger is equivalent to a level 35 elite, which is still a great pressure for Wang Shuo and others.

After annihilating Qingmu Village and Fengze Village, Wang Shuo's level is still a little short of level 26, and Ayub is only level 29.

The levels of others are even lower.

The tiger knight immediately pounced over, and Wang Shuo dodged to the side, making way for more soldiers to enter the hall.

Wang Shuo glanced at the back hall casually.

The paint-chipped pillars, carved windows, and several solid wood chairs inside.

The hall looks very spacious and can accommodate more than 40 people, but it is still a bit difficult to fight in it.

Wang Shuo ordered 40 soldiers to deal with the tiger knight, while the other main combat forces directly faced the silver boss Xu Wen.

"Iron Chain Binding" was activated.

But facing a high-level boss, the skill that could have lasted for 10 seconds.

Xu Wen only took 2 seconds to break free.

Although it did not achieve the expected effect, it also created a good output environment for Gong Zheng, Guliji and others.

"Upright and awe-inspiring."

A pale yellow halo appeared on Xu Wen's body.

His defense directly increased from 80 points to 580 points.

"Oh my god, this is too much!"

None of Wang Shuo and others could break his defense.

In desperation, Gong Zheng could only take over. Gong Zheng directly turned into a stone giant, and neither of them could do anything to the other.

Wang Shuo made a tentative attack, and after finding that he really couldn't beat him, he turned to attack the three tiger knights.

After a stalemate of half an hour, Xu Wen's defense value finally returned to normal.

At the same time, the three tiger knights were also eliminated.

Everyone began to focus on Xu Wen.

At this time, Xu Wen launched "Upright and awe-inspiring" again.

Wang Shuo was so angry that he wanted to vomit blood.

The three tiger knights were also summoned again.

Wang Shuo had a bad premonition in his heart. If this cycle continued, Xu Wen could exhaust people alive.

"Attack with all your strength!"

A firm look flashed in Wang Shuo's eyes.

We must find a way to deal with the attack.

After having some experience in dealing with it, it only took 20 minutes to kill the Tiger Knight.

Then everyone focused on dealing with Xu Wen.

Wang Shuo found that as long as he could attack effectively, he could still speed up the consumption of the opponent's skills.

This ignited a bit of fighting spirit in Wang Shuo.

"We still have to find a way to interrupt the opponent's skills."

Soon, Xu Wen released his skills again, still using the same trick.

Wang Shuo held his breath and looked carefully.
